synopsis: Chapter 3 and the glossary consistently describe ISO/IEC TR 5469:2024 as guidance on AI and functional safety, not a requirements document or a machine-learning safety requirement [f2100, f2383, f15053, f15299]. It was published in January 2024, and Chapter 3 explicitly says it imposes no testing requirements [f2382, f2726, f2727]. The glossary further distinguishes Technical Reports from full standards and explains that the ISO/IEC designation names the two participating bodies [f15053, f15019]. However, Chapter 13 lists this document among relevant leads that were not verified in the research, creating an unresolved verification gap despite the definite descriptions elsewhere [f11198, f2383, f15299].
